name: Tendou Jin
source:
Jin was a top student in junior high school, but his grades have seriously declined in high school. He is a student at Hanegasaki High ([url=http://vndb.org/v858]Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side: 2nd Kiss[/url]'s high school.) Basically, Jin's the kind of guy who hangs out on the streets and engages in gang battles. But as the plot progresses, you discover he isn't the average thug.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side]Wikipedia[/url] and [url=http://www.gamefaqs.com/ds/934799-tokimeki-memorial-girls-side-1st-love/faqs/48851]GameFAQs[/url]]
